accepted_design: Preserve mandatory inner failure publication first.
After executor ACK, supervisor best-effort polls its exact child under same shared pool, then sends existing validated worker_wait at most once.
Use proposed1.0s inner reserve as an internal allocation only, not extra allowance or guaranteed scheduling latency; record cap-truncated reaping unproven.
Own-child fallback guarded; failed ACK skips extended wait, no ACK retries or writes after missingACK.
Executor drains bounded existing IPC before constructing failed receipt inside existing until-.25 reserve.
Derived reaping fields use only validated raw wait reports; group absence never establishes direct reaping.

Preregister fixture classes from injected scenario: success unchanged; live supervisor requires worker wait; deliberate parent death requires positive orphan absence and explicit unproven reaping, with case milestones proving why.
Retain every success acceptance PID/rawstatus/directparent/time/registration/integrity predicate unchanged.
confirmed: Actual supervisor failure branch does not poll/reap its spawned child after acknowledged cancellation, leaving only group absence in retained r6 case.
deferred_optional_change: Do not change post-failure reset classification merely to make diagnostics quieter; retain bounded IPC error evidence unless broad review demonstrates a necessary correction.
qualifications: Worker ppid-at-gate and startup scheduling sequence are source/evidence-derived, not live-observed facts.
No original-parent wait report is retained; init may reap orphans, so do not claim no process could ever reap the worker.
Child wrapper construction can fail; fallback must be guarded, not assumed infallible.

A killed supervisor can have sent a legitimate wait before death; reject a present worker wait only in the specific preregistered parent-death fixture with positive live-worker/no-prior-report milestone.
Raw socketpair probe used system Python3.9, not registered Channel/project interpreter; it supports a bounded drain hypothesis only.
